acceptance: Frontend dev server serves the PAL app in a real browser at its bound port with no console errors, page errors or failed requests
Backend FastAPI runs against the user's existing PostgreSQL and answers a DB-backed endpoint with real company rows (not a hang or 500)
Core UI routes (dashboard, invoices, bank, review, vendors, audit, tally) render their headings against live data
Tally connectivity endpoint responds and reports connected:false honestly while TallyPrime itself is not running, instead of crashing
Mobile viewport (390px) shows no horizontal overflow on the dashboard
change.reason: Defining what "run the project" means as observable outcomes, from what actually happened: frontend bound to 8080 (5173 is held by a Windows svchost reservation, and 8080 is already in backend CORS_ORIGINS so no config was changed), backend uvicorn on 8082 pointed at the user's Docker/WSL PostgreSQL on 5432, and TallyPrime not listening on 9000. The earlier hang was the DB being down before 09:55, not a defect: /health stayed ok and after Postgres came up /api/v1/companies returned 3 rows. Also corrected one false alarm of my own: /review not showing the word "Voucher" is correct behaviour - review.tsx:43 titles it "Review Queue" and VoucherReview is only mounted from invoice-voucher.tsx/bank-voucher.tsx.
